method: HyperFrames 0.9.26 (HTML → video), sources in films/<id>/, built by films/build-films.mjs and rendered by films/render-films.mjs; previous Pillow version replaced
framing: 4 scenes of 4 s on the app caption clock: question and set-up → the change you see and hear → the part that changed, named → one-line answer and 삐오 reacts
audio: No music or narration. One effect per visible action from the game's own CC0 recordings (media/audio/experiments/sources.json): loudness by gain only (same drum, 0.22 vs 1.0), pitch by playback rate only (ruler ×1 vs ×2.5, as src/audio.js 260→650 Hz), both ruler lengths share one gentle compression
art: Existing project props and concept illustrations, 삐오 (image/generated/pio-guide.svg); hand, waves, arcs and labels drawn in code
